description: Independent synthetic comparisons, not a complete distributed model analysis or real device benchmark. C03 KV arithmetic comes from docs/DATA_CONTRACT_DETAILS.md. Ring payload, bandwidth and latency are explicit mathematical assumptions. Missing local HBM/reduction work is intentionally diagnosed.

algorithm.name: Explicit assumed ring factor 2*(4-1)/4 and 3 startup rounds

assumptions: Send and receive payload are explicitly declared per member; algorithmTraffic = send payload × trafficFactor, applied exactly once.
Bandwidth/latency time uses per-sender algorithm traffic and startupRounds; the group total time is a collective span, not a sum over devices.
This evaluator models network transfer only. Local HBM reads/writes, staging allocation, reduction arithmetic and quantization conversion work require separate declarations.
